chunks: The infidels will remain in doubt about it till the Hour overtakes them unawares, or the punishment of the barren day destructive should come upon them.
ai.seo_question: What is the state of disbelievers before the Hour of Judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj highlights the inevitable collapse of the disbelievers' skepticism, contrasting their lingering doubt with the suddenness of the Hour or the severity of 'Yawm al-Aqeem' (the Barren Day). The term 'Aqeem' signifies a day of reckoning that yields no fruit or benefit for those who rejected the truth, emphasizing the finality of divine justice. This reinforces the Shia understanding of the transition from worldly doubt to the absolute reality of the Hereafter.
